claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Nitrofurazone is a prodrug that requires bacterial nitroreductase activation and is not appreciably activated by human cells; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against human cancer cell lines, with any killing being weak and non-selective.
